questions.question: Simplify the following. 25³ - 75³ + 50³
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The number 253 - 753 + 503.

253 - 753 + 503

⇒ 15625 - 421875 + 125000

⇒ - 281250

**∴ The required answer is - 281250.**

questions.question: Find the greatest 5-digit number which is divisible by 11, 33, 99, and 121.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

11, 33, 99, 121 divide the required largest five-digit numbers.

**Concept used:**

If any number N is divisible by a set of numbers a, b, c, d, e then N is also divisible by LCM of a, b, c, d, and e

**Calculation:**

The largest five-digit number is 99999

LCM of 11, 33, 99, 121 = 1089

As we know by the concept,

1089 should divide by either 99999 or the five-digit number nearest to 99999

When we divide 99999 by 1089, we get Reminder = 900

99999 - 900 = 99099

99099 is divisible by 1089

**∴ 99099 is the largest five-digit number which is divisible by 11, 33, 99, 121.**

questions.question: The fourth proportion to 12, 24 and 27 is the same as the third proportion to A and 36. What is the value of A?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Numbers = 12, 24 and 27 

**Calculation: **

Forth proportions 12, 24 and 27 is n, 

⇒ 12 : 24 :: 27 : n 

⇒ 12/24 = 27/n 

⇒ n = 54 

Then,

Third proportional to A and 36 is 54. 

⇒ A : 36 = 36 : 54 

⇒ 54A = 36² 

⇒ A = 24 

**∴ The value of A is 24.**

questions.question:
A shopkeeper offers three types of discount schemes for buyers. Which of them has the maximum discount percentage?

I. Two successive discounts of 10% each.

II. Successive discounts of 15% and 5%.

III. 20% discount.
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Effective discount = D₁ + D₂ - (D₁.D₂)/100

Here,

D1 = Discount 1

D2 = Discount 2

**Calculation:**

Statement I:

Effective discount = 10 + 10 - (10 × 10)/100

⇒ 20 - 1

⇒ 19%

Statement II:

Effective discount = 15 + 5 - (15 × 5)/100

⇒ 20 - 0.75

⇒ 19.25%

Statement III:

20% discount

So, from these three third discount scheme is the best

**∴ The required answer is Option 3.**

questions.question: The lengths (in cm) of three sides of a triangle are, respectively, 48, 55 and 73. What is the length (in cm) of the median joining the mid-point of the longest side to its opposite vertex?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The lengths (in cm) of three sides of a triangle are, respectively, 48, 55 and 73.

**Concept used:**

Median of a right angle triangle = H/2

Here,

H = hypotenuse

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c8bc441d703d23248f4ee5a22f8665add4e804311cd044c1c038959d4404209.png] 

48² + 55² 

⇒ 2304 + 3025

⇒ 5329

⇒ 73²

So, the triangle is a right-angle triangle

So, median = h/2 = 73/2

⇒ 36.5

**∴ The required answer is 36.5 cm.**

questions.question: What is the smallest number that should be added to 4567 so that the sum is divisible by 7?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

When 4567 is divided by 7

We get 3 as the remainder

So, the number which is divisible by 7 after 4567 = 4567 - 3 + 7

⇒ 4571

Required number = 4571 - 4567

⇒ 4

**∴ The smallest number that should be added to 4567 so that the sum is divisible by 7 is 4.**

questions.question: A businessman cheats by using faulty weights, to the tune of 12% each time, when buying and selling material. What is the rise in his profit percentage using faulty weights only?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A shopkeeper cheats while buying as well as selling = 12%

**Formula Used: **

Profit% = a + b + (a × b)/100

**Calculation: **

Profit% = 12 + 12 + (12 × 12)/100 = 25.44

**∴ The shopkeeper earned 25.44% profit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

This question is from one of the official papers of SSC. 

According to SSC's approach, the correct answer is 25.44%, as it follows the method of successive profit.

It's crucial to understand that there are various methods to solve such questions and these methods can differ based on the exam board. For example, IBPS and other banking boards might yield an answer of 27.27% for a similar problem, but in this case, as we're considering the SSC exam, we don't take that into account, especially when it's not among the given options.

questions.solution:

If the perimeter of the triangle is "p"

Let Total possible triangles "t"

If p = even, then

t = p²/48

If p = odd, then

t = (p + 3)²/48

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Total possible triangles = (13 + 3)²/48

⇒ 5.33 ≈ 5

**∴ Total possible triangles are 5.**

questions.question: A person travels from P to Q at a speed of 50 km/h and returns by increasing his speed by 60%. What is his average speed for both the trips?
questions.solution:

**Concept used:**

Average speed = 2S₁S₂/(S₁ + S₂)

Here S1, S2 are the speed

**Calculation:**

Speed at time of returning = 50 × 160%

⇒ 80 km/h

Average speed = (2 × 50 × 80)/(50 + 80)

⇒ 8000/130

⇒ 61.53

**∴ The average speed for both trips is 61.53 km/h.**

questions.question: The volume of the hemisphere is 19,404 cm³ . The radius of the hemisphere is _______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The volume of the hemisphere is 19,404 cm3

**Concept used:**

The volume of a hemisphere = 2/3πr³

Here r = radius

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

2/3πr³ = 19404

⇒ 2/3 × 22/7 × r3 = 19404

⇒ 2/3 × 22/7 × r3 = 19404

⇒ r3 = 9261

⇒ r = 21

So, radius = 21 cm

**∴ The radius of the hemisphere is 21 cm.**

questions.question: 40 men can complete a work in 15 days. Three days after they started working, 20 more men joined them. In how many days the total work will be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

40 men can complete work in 15 days

Number of days 40 men worked = 3 days

20 new men are joined 

**Concept used:**

Work = time × efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of each man be 'm'.

Total work = 40 × m × 15 

⇒ 600m

Work done in 3 days = 40 × 3 × m

⇒ 120m

Remaining work = 600m - 120m = 480m

Let the number of days needed to complete the remaining work be N

So, 60 × N × m = 480m

⇒ N = 8

So, total time = 3 + 8

⇒ 11 days

**∴ The total work will be completed in 11 days.**
